profile.campus: PLAY Katowice Gospodarcza Data Center Campus (DC1/DC2/DC3)
profile.reading: This is PLAY Centrum Danych DC2, at Gospodarcza 12 in Katowice, Poland, one of two existing data center buildings in the PLAY Katowice Gospodarcza complex, operated under the 3S Data Center brand. 3S Data Center belongs to the 3S Group, which Polish mobile operator Play, legally P4 sp. z o.o., acquired in 2019 for 410 million zloty, bringing the groups Katowice, Bytom, and other Polish data center sites under Play ownership. A directory listing describes DC2 specifically as Tier 3 certified with ISO 27001 compliance. Trade press coverage describes DC1 and DC2 together occupying roughly 2,200 square meters within the Katowice Gospodarcza complex, which Play has since expanded with a newly built DC3 building of about 2,200 square meters more, bringing the complexs total footprint toward 4,400 square meters and adding Tier 3+ rated capacity. Play also operates PLAY branded data centers elsewhere in Poland, including a facility in Bytom. Play itself was founded in February 2007 and grew into Polands second largest mobile network operator behind Orange Polska, reporting over 15.6 million subscribers by 2021. French telecom group Iliad agreed to buy Play in a 2.2 billion euro deal announced in September 2020, completing a tender offer that left Iliad holding 96.66 percent of Play by November 2020, and Iliad later merged UPC Poland, acquired separately from Liberty Global, into Play in August 2023, consolidating both mobile and fixed line infrastructure, including data center assets like this one, under the same French parent. The 3S Group as a whole has operated for about 20 years, employs roughly 300 people, and maintains a 6,000 kilometer fiber network connecting its Katowice data center hub to regional offices in Warsaw, Cracow, Wroclaw, and Gdansk, where it opened a further, smaller data center of over 500 square meters on Nowy Swiat Street to serve the Tri-City and Pomeranian region, offering its proprietary Cloud2B cloud computing platform alongside network, unified communications, and data security services to Polish business customers.
profile.research_note: Researched fresh 2026-09-04. This row was not previously scope-flagged but had never been researched. The 2,200 sqm figure for DC1+DC2 combined is described in prose only, not applied as a fact-box technical_space_sqft value, since no per-building breakdown was found and applying the combined figure to each building individually would overstate size; facility_codes (DC2) used instead as the third fact-box key.
